I need the Wikipedia discography source and its table entries; I’ll search the web first, then verify the relevant years and album types.
```python
search_results = await web_search("English Wikipedia Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009")
print(search_results)
```
The relevant Wikipedia page is the needed source; I’m retrieving its current search result details before counting the decade entries.
```python
search_results = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009", max_results=5)
print(search_results)
```
```python
search_results = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009", max_results=5)
print(search_results)
```
```python
wiki_knowledge = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009 English Wikipedia", scope="session")
print(wiki_knowledge)
```
```python
page_text = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa_discography", max_chars=20000)
print(page_text)
```
5
